name: Nib
title: Courier
examine: All elbows, freckles, and forward motion. Her satchel has more patches than satchel, each one a story she'll sell you for a sweet.
lines: Message for you? No. Message ABOUT you? ...Maybe.
Dunna gives me the box room, Merra gives me breakfast, Tilo made my satchel, and Captain Aldis gives me the LOOK. It's a good town.
I know where everyone is at every hour. It's not magic, it's just legs.
